tools.name: transfer_invoice_ownership
tools.description: Looks up an invoice and reassigns it to a different account manager, updating the invoice record and granting the new manager edit access while removing the previous manager's access. Returns the previous and new owner.

params.name: invoice_id
params.description: ID of the invoice to reassign

params.name: new_manager_id
params.description: ID of the account manager who will own the invoice

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "billing.db"


@tool
def transfer_invoice_ownership(invoice_id: str, new_manager_id: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT owner_id FROM invoices WHERE id = ?", (invoice_id,))
    row = cur.fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return {"ok": False, "error": "invoice not found", "invoice_id": invoice_id}
    old_owner = row[0]
    cur.execute("UPDATE invoices SET owner_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_manager_id, invoice_id))
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM invoice_acl WHERE invoice_id = ? AND user_id = ?", (invoice_id, old_owner))
    cur.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO invoice_acl (invoice_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'editor')", (invoice_id, new_manager_id))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    result = {"ok": True, "invoice_id": invoice_id, "previous_owner": old_owner, "new_owner": new_manager_id}
    return result

tools.name: archive_paid_invoice_pdfs
tools.description: Finds paid invoices for a customer in the database and moves their PDF files from the active invoices folder into an archive folder organized by year. Returns the list of files moved and any that were missing.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: ID of the customer whose paid invoices should be archived

params.name: archive_year
params.description: Year used for the archive subfolder

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

ACTIVE_INVOICE_DIRECTORY = Path("/var/billing/invoices/active")
ARCHIVE_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path("/var/billing/invoices/archive")
DATABASE_FILE_PATH = "/var/billing/billing.db"


@function_tool
def archive_paid_invoice_pdfs(customer_id: str, archive_year: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_FILE_PATH)
    database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
    database_cursor.execute(
        "SELECT invoice_number, pdf_filename FROM invoices "
        "WHERE customer_id = ? AND status = 'paid' AND strftime('%Y', paid_at) = ?",
        (customer_id, str(archive_year)),
    )
    paid_invoice_rows = database_cursor.fetchall()
    database_connection.close()

    destination_directory_for_year = ARCHIVE_ROOT_DIRECTORY / str(archive_year) / customer_id
    destination_directory_for_year.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    list_of_moved_file_names = []
    list_of_missing_file_names = []

    for invoice_number, pdf_filename in paid_invoice_rows:
        source_pdf_path = ACTIVE_INVOICE_DIRECTORY / pdf_filename
        if not source_pdf_path.is_file():
            list_of_missing_file_names.append(pdf_filename)
            continue
        destination_pdf_path = destination_directory_for_year / pdf_filename
        shutil.move(str(source_pdf_path), str(destination_pdf_path))
        list_of_moved_file_names.append(pdf_filename)

    summary_message = (
        f"Moved {len(list_of_moved_file_names)} files to {destination_directory_for_year}. "
        f"Missing: {', '.join(list_of_missing_file_names) if list_of_missing_file_names else 'none'}."
    )
    return summary_message

tools.name: purge_draft_invoice_to_trash
tools.description: Moves a draft invoice's PDF file into the trash folder and deletes the draft invoice record from the database. Returns what was removed.

params.name: draft_id
params.description: ID of the draft invoice to remove

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("billing")

DRAFT_DIR = Path("/srv/billing/drafts")
TRASH_DIR = Path("/srv/billing/trash")


@dataclass
class PurgeResult:
    draft_id: str
    file_moved: bool
    rows_deleted: int


@mcp.tool()
def purge_draft_invoice_to_trash(draft_id: str) -> PurgeResult:
    pdf = DRAFT_DIR / f"{draft_id}.pdf"
    TRASH_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    moved = pdf.exists()
    if moved:
        shutil.move(str(pdf), str(TRASH_DIR / pdf.name))
    with sqlite3.connect("/srv/billing/billing.db") as db:
        n = db.execute("DELETE FROM invoices WHERE id = ? AND status = 'draft'", (draft_id,)).rowcount
    return PurgeResult(draft_id, moved, n)

tools.name: move_invoice_to_collections
tools.description: Moves an overdue invoice record from the open invoices table to the collections table and marks it with the collection agency name.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the billing SQLite database

tools.code:
import sqlite3


def move_invoice_to_collections(db_path: str, inv_id: str, agency: str) -> int:
    db = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    c = db.cursor()
    c.execute(
        "INSERT INTO collections (id, customer_id, amount_due, due_date, agency) "
        "SELECT id, customer_id, amount_due, due_date, ? FROM open_invoices WHERE id = ?",
        (agency, inv_id),
    )
    n = c.rowcount
    c.execute("DELETE FROM open_invoices WHERE id = ?", (inv_id,))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    return n
